reason: This is an AI-agent automation guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness that enforces operator-defined write policies before tool execution. Its primary function is execution-governance: it checks actions against deterministic constraints and optionally adds semantic LLM review, then logs contradiction outcomes, so it is best classified as automation rather than content generation, UI, or analytics tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 AI 编码代理的执行前策略插件，在工具调用前按用户定义的约束规则进行拦截与判定，并在必要时阻断不合规操作并输出审计记录。
summaries.en: This is a pre-execution policy plugin for AI coding agents that evaluates tool calls against user-defined constraints, can apply an optional semantic judge, and blocks non-compliant actions while recording audit events.

capabilities: Intercepts AI agent tool calls before execution and can deny actions.
Applies deterministic checks from operator-defined commitments (paths, commands, scopes).
Optionally routes selected checks to an LLM judge via a configured provider endpoint.
Emits contradiction/audit data for blocked actions to log output.

reasons.code: Two-tier pre-execution policy (deterministic guard + semantic judge) is applied before tool execution.
Configuration-driven commitments use command/path rules and scoped tool kinds; violations are recorded as events/JSONL logs.
Package metadata exposes DeepSeek Harness integration and peer dependencies needed for runtime tool orchestration.
